question: Why does Bhairava praise the goddess for asking a question rare among gods?
premises: Bhairava expresses strong approval to the great goddess.
He states that he has been asked a question.
The matter asked about is hard to obtain even for the gods.
inference: Bhairava praises the goddess because she has asked about something rare and hard for the gods to obtain.
plain_english: Well said, well said, O great goddess; you have asked me about something hard for even the gods to obtain.
